data.name: NucleMon
data.detailed_description:
NucleMon is a creature collection and creature building game where you play as a newly evolved lifeform with transformation ability. Collect and transform into various NucleMon, freely building their abilities using diverse genetic traits. Explore, battle, and and build your very own NucleMon.

Customize NucleMon Abilities Freely

With over 200 unique genes, you can freely equip any NucleMon to create unexpected and magical effects. Enjoy unparalleled freedom—each NucleMon holds infinite possibilities.

Explore a Unique World

Experience naturally generated ecosystems, rich interactive environments, more than 50 distinct enemies, and several powerful bosses.

Realistic Physics Simulation

Elements react in highly realistic ways, break terrain, destroy environments, and set everything on fire.

Diverse Combat Styles

Over 20 different NucleMon await discovery across the map, each possessing its own unique combat style.

Build Your Own Team

You can record up to four NucleMon at once, forming your personalized transformation team, and freely switch between them during battles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 / OpenGL 3.3 capable (Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GTX 460 or better)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
